title: Dizon to meet transport groups as Manibela readies 2-day strike

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transportation Secretary Vince Dizon said he would meet with transport groups next week to discuss their concerns, as one group prepares to stage a two-day transport strike over the possible replacement of the Land Transportation Office (LTO) chief. “I will talk to the transport groups next week,” Dizon told reporters.
